behavior: Map the six inbound HTTP operations to explicit application ports without owning purchase rules.

sourceBinding.status: source-reconciled specification; no current runtime or compliance verdict

endpoints.location: Get purchase URL for 201/202; 201 does not imply supplier acceptance (Rejected is a settled outcome)

endpoints.limit: fixed default 100; no query limit/pagination binding

spec.errorScope: Only exceptions escaping the use case reach this mapping. Create/reconcile may absorb gateway failures and return a 202 order instead. A malformed Guid path can fail route matching with 404; invalid JSON/body binding is 400.

CreatePurchaseRequest.name: productId
CreatePurchaseRequest.constraint: nonempty reference; existence is not checked here

CreatePurchaseRequest.name: unitPrice
CreatePurchaseRequest.constraint: 0..9999999999999999.99; rounding to two decimal places leaves the numeric value unchanged

CreatePurchaseRequest.name: provider
CreatePurchaseRequest.constraint: direct | wiremock | microcks, exact named value

contracts.problemDetails: status/title/detail plus extensions code/message; invalid body code=invalid_request with at most five model-state errors in message
contracts.serialization: ASP.NET web JSON camelCase fields; state serialized with JsonStringEnumConverter and declared enum names

policies.idempotency: ClientRequestId for purchase identity; ReceiptId for physical receipt. No HTTP stock side effect on acceptance.
policies.authentication: No deployment authentication/authorization middleware in this lab host. Local-only exposure is a deployment setting, not in-process authentication.
policies.validation: Delegate to use cases/domain and framework model binding; no claim of product existence validation.
policies.cancellation: Pass request CancellationToken. Create persists unknown with CancellationToken.None when supplier submission is cancelled after the local identity commit, then rethrows. Reconcile propagates caller cancellation without marking unknown.

hostNotes.health: GET /health checks PostgreSQL SELECT 1 only; does not establish broker/supplier/schema readiness
hostNotes.gateway: YARP frontend configuration forwards /api/procurement paths; the application base path stays unchanged
